newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta's Mid-Med extends rates offer.
newsitem.headline: Malta's Mid-Med extends rates offer.

text.p: Malta's Mid-Med bank said on Monday it was extending to the end of this month an offer of concessionary interest rates for customers to renew and repatriate funds to two and three-year foreign currency deposits.
Under the scheme, the interest rate on Sterling deposit accounts is 6.375 percent for two years and 6.750 percent for three years, the bank said.
For Candian dollars it is 3.750 percent for two years and 4.375 percent for three years and for Australian dollars is 5.875 percent for two years and 6.125 percent for three years.
For U.S.dollars, the interest rate is 5.5 percent for two years and 5.625 percent for three years.
The minimum amount in deposit must be equivalent to 2,000 Maltese pounds ($5,180), the bank added.
